Any of the former chief temples to YHWH in Jerusalem, particularly Solomon's Temple.

tempo.definition: The number of beats per minute in a piece of music; also, an indicative term denoting approximate rate of speed in written music (examples: allegro, andante)
examples: The conductor asked the orchestra to increase the tempo.
The song has a slow tempo that makes it relaxing.
The dancer kept pace with the shifting tempo of the music.

tempt.definition: To provoke someone to do wrong, especially by promising a reward; to entice.
examples: She tempted me to eat the apple.

temptation.definition: Something attractive, tempting or seductive; an inducement, seducement, or enticement.

tempura.definition: A Japanese dish made by deep-frying vegetables, seafood, or other foods in a light batter.

ten.definition: The number occurring after nine and before eleven, represented in Arabic numerals (base ten) as 10 and in Roman numerals as X.

tenacious.definition: Unwilling to yield or give up; dogged.

tend.definition: To be likely, or probable to do something, or to have a certain habit or leaning.
examples: They tend to go out on Saturdays.
It tends to snow here in winter.
I was tending to get up later and later after the breakup.

tendency.definition: A likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction; a tending toward.
examples: Denim has a tendency to fade.
I have a tendency to get bored after the first half an hour of a movie.
There's a common tendency among first-game visitors to a casino to bet overcautiously.

tender.definition: A means of payment such as a check or cheque, cash or credit card.
examples: Your credit card has been declined so you need to provide some other tender such as cash.
legal tender

tender.definition: A formal offer to buy or sell something.
examples: We will submit our tender to you within the week.

tendon.definition: A tough band of flexible but inelastic fibrous collagen tissue that connects a muscle with its bony attachment and transmits the force which the muscle exerts.

tennessee.definition: A state of the United States.

tennis.definition: A sport played by two players (or four in doubles), who alternately strike the ball over a net using racquets.

tenon.definition: A projecting member left by cutting away the wood around it, and made to insert into a mortise, and in this way secure together the parts of a frame.

tense.definition: The property of indicating the point in time at which an action or state of being occurs or exists.
examples: Dyirbal verbs are not inflected for tense.

tense.definition: Showing signs of stress or strain; not relaxed.
examples: You need to relax, all this overtime and stress is making you tense.

tension.definition: A psychological state of being tense.

tent.definition: A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.
examples: We were camping in a three-man tent.
We bought a new tent that can be put up in five seconds, but it took about twenty minutes to take it down and pack it away.

tentacle.definition: An elongated, boneless, flexible organ or limb of some animals, such as the octopus and squid.

tenth.definition: The ordinal numeral form of ten; next in order after that which is ninth.

tenure.definition: A status of having a permanent post with enhanced job security within an academic institution.

tepid.definition: Uninterested; exhibiting little passion or eagerness; lukewarm.
examples: He gave me a tepid response to the proposal.

tequila.definition: An alcoholic liquor distilled from the fermented juice of the Central American century plant Agave tequilana.

tequixquiac.definition: A municipality of the State of Mexico, Mexico. Seat: Santiago Tequixquiac.

tercet.definition: a three-line stanza in a poem

terebinth.definition: A Mediterranean tree (Pistacia terebinthus and, possibly, Pistacia palaestina)

teresa.definition: A female given name from Ancient Greek, the Spanish and Italian form of Theresa.

term.definition: A unit or component with a certain meaning. A word or phrase (e.g., noun phrase, verb phrase, open compound), especially one from a specialised area of knowledge; a name for a concept.
examples: "Algorithm" is a term used in computer science.
The noun phrase "red blood cell", the acronym "RBC", and the word "erythrocyte" are synonymous terms.

terminal.definition: A building in an airport where passengers transfer from ground transportation to the facilities that allow them to board airplanes.
examples: Terminal 1 is for domestic flights, whereas Terminal 2 is for international flights.
A shuttle service runs free of charge between the three terminals.

terminate.definition: To end something, especially when left in an incomplete state.
examples: to terminate a process before its completion
to terminate an effort, or a controversy

terminology.definition: A treatise on terms, especially those used in a specialised field.

termite.definition: A colonial insect of the infraorder Isoptera, in the order Blattodea; typically known for certain white-bodied species that devour and infest wood, though other species eat different plant matter, such as grasses.

ternopil.definition: A city, administrative center, and raion of Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine.

terpsichore.definition: The goddess of dance and the dramatic chorus, and one of the Muses; the daughters of Zeus & Mnemosyne.

terrace.definition: A platform that extends outwards from a building.

terramare.definition: Bronze Age lake dwellings and settlements of the Po valley in northern Italy, characterized by the presence of ammoniacal earthy deposit (black marl) in mounds.

terrible.definition: Causing terror, alarm or fear; dreadful
examples: The witch laid a terrible curse on him.
The food was terrible, but it was free.

territory.definition: A large extent or tract of land; for example a region, country or district.
An area that an animal of a particular species consistently defends against its conspecifics.

examples: a terror attack
the War on Terror

terrorism.definition: The system of fear and intimidation put into place during the Reign of Terror in Revolutionary France around 1793-94.

terrorist.definition: A person, group, or organization that uses violent action, or the threat of violent action, to further political goals.

terse.definition: Of speech or style: brief, concise, to the point.

tertiary.definition: Of third rank or order; subsequent.

test.definition: A challenge, trial. An examination, given often during the academic term.

testament.definition: A solemn, authentic instrument in writing, by which a person declares his or her will as to disposal of his or her inheritance (estate and effects) after his or her death, benefiting specified heir(s).

testicle.definition: A testis: the male sex and endocrine gland, found in most types of animals, that produces sperm and male sex hormones, including the steroid testosterone.

testimony.definition: Statements made by a witness in court.

testosterone.definition: A steroid hormone that stimulates development of male secondary sexual characteristics, produced mainly in the testes, but also in the ovaries and adrenal cortex.

tetanus.definition: A serious and often fatal disease caused by the infection of an open wound with the anaerobic bacterium Clostridium tetani, found in soil and the intestines and faeces of animals.

teth.definition: The ninth letter of many Semitic alphabets/abjads (Phoenician, Aramaic, Hebrew, Syriac, Arabic and others).

tetrahedron.definition: A polyhedron with four faces; the regular tetrahedron, the faces of which are equal equilateral triangles, is one of the Platonic solids.

tetrahydrocannabinol.definition: The psychoactive substance present in cannabis, a hydrogenated derivative of cannabinol.

tetration.definition: The arithmetic operator consisting of repeated exponentiation, by analogy with exponentiation being repeated multiplication and multiplication being repeated addition, ᵇᵃ denoting a to the power of a to the power of … to the power of a, in which a appears b times.

tetris.definition: A puzzle video game in which falling tetrominoes must be manipulated to form complete lines, which are then cleared from the grid.

tevet.definition: The fourth month of the civil year and the tenth month of the ecclesiastical year in the Jewish calendar, after Kislev and before Shevat.

texas.definition: a state of the United States of America

text.definition: A book, tome or other set of writings.
Ellipsis of text message, a brief written message transmitted between mobile phones.

textbook.definition: A coursebook, a formal manual of instruction in a specific subject, especially one for use in schools or colleges.

thai.definition: A person living in or coming from Thailand.
The main language spoken in Thailand (closely related to Lao).

thailand.definition: A country in Southeast Asia; formerly, Siam. Official name: Kingdom of Thailand. Capital: Bangkok.

thames.definition: A river in southern England, flowing 336 km (209 mi.) from Gloucestershire, through Wiltshire, Oxfordshire, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Surrey and Greater London, and between Essex and Kent to the Thames Estuary and North Sea.

than.definition: Introduces a comparison, and is associated with comparatives, and with words such as more, less, and fewer. Typically, it seeks to measure the force of an adjective or similar description between two predicates.
examples: Patients diagnosed more recently are probably surviving an average of longer than two years.
No player is more skillful than Greg.

thanatos.definition: The death drive in Freudian psychoanalysis.

thank.definition: To express appreciation or gratitude toward (someone or something).
examples: She thanked him for the lift.

thank.definition: Chiefly followed by for: to credit or hold (someone or something) responsible, especially for something negative; to blame.
examples: We can thank global warming for this freak weather.
We have two sick newborns to thank for our lack of sleep lately.

thanks.definition: Used to express appreciation or gratitude.
examples: Could you give me a hand, please? — Yes, sure. — Thanks. —Have you got enough now? —Yes, thanks.
Would you like some potatoes? — Thanks. —How many?

that.definition: Introducing a subordinate clause that expresses an aim, purpose, or goal ("final"), and usually contains the auxiliaries may, might, or should: so, so that, in order that.
examples: He fought that others might have peace.

that.definition: The (thing, person, idea, etc) indicated or understood from context, especially if more remote physically, temporally or mentally than one designated as "this", or if expressing distinction.
examples: That book is a good read. This one isn't.
That battle was in 1450.
That cat of yours is evil.

thatcher.definition: A surname originating as an occupation.

thaw.definition: To gradually cause (something frozen, such as earth, ice, or snow) to melt or soften by raising the temperature.
Of something frozen, such as earth, ice, or snow: to gradually melt or soften as a result of the temperature being raised.
examples: the ice thaws

thaw.definition: A gradual melting or softening of something frozen (such as earth, ice, or snow) when the temperature rises; the transformation of something frozen into a fluid or semifluid.

theater.definition: A place or building, consisting of a stage and seating, in which an audience gathers to watch plays, musical performances, public ceremonies, and so on.

theatrical.definition: Of or relating to the theatre.

examples: resource theft
Bike theft is on the rise.
A suspect was arrested for the theft of a gold necklace.

their.definition: Belonging to, from, of, or relating to, them (plural).
examples: they will meet tomorrow at their convenience
this is probably their cat

theme.definition: A subject, now especially of a talk or an artistic piece; a topic.
computing: collection of color schemes, sounds, artwork etc.

examples: He was happy then.
He fixed it, then left.
Turn left, then right, then right again, then keep going until you reach the service station.
And then came an invitation to tonight's ball.
If it’s locked, then we’ll need the key.
Is it 12 o’clock already? Then it’s time for me to leave.
You don’t like potatoes? What do you want me to cook, then?

theocracy.definition: Government under the control of a state religion.
examples: Tibet was a Buddhist theocracy ruled by the Dalai Lama prior to Chinese annexation.
The Vatican City State is a sovereign city-state and a Christian theocracy ruled by the Pope.

theodolite.definition: A surveying instrument, consisting of a small mounted telescope, used to measure horizontal and vertical angles.

theodore.definition: A male given name from Latin [in turn from Ancient Greek]; the name of a saint, pope, several emperors, etc.

theology.definition: The study of God, a god, or gods; and of the truthfulness of religion in general.

theorbo.definition: A baroque, double-necked lute having an extra set of open bass strings.

theorem.definition: A mathematical statement that is expected to be true.
examples: Fermat's Last Theorem was known thus long before it was proved in the 1990s.

theoretic.definition: Concerned with theories or hypotheses rather than with practical matters.
Existing only in theory, not proven in reality.

theory.definition: A coherent statement or set of ideas that explains observed facts or phenomena and correctly predicts new facts or phenomena not previously observed, or which sets out the laws and principles of something known or observed; a hypothesis confirmed by observation, experiment etc.

there.definition: to or into that place; thither (movement)

therefore.definition: Consequently, by or in consequence of that or this cause; referring to something previously stated.
examples: Traditional values will always have a place—therefore, they will never lose relevance.
I've been explicitly forbidden to leave and therefore must stay longer.
I left the office at 5 o'clock. I was therefore not there when the fire started a quarter of an hour later.

thermidor.definition: The eleventh month of the French Republican Calendar, from July 19 or 20 to August 17 or 18.

thermodynamics.definition: The science of the conversions between heat and other forms of energy.

thermometer.definition: An apparatus used to measure temperature.

thermos.definition: A bottle, flask or similar vessel having a vacuum between its inner and outer silvered walls; designed to maintain the temperature of its contents

thermosphere.definition: The layer of the Earth's atmosphere directly above the mesosphere and directly below the exosphere.

thermostat.definition: A device that automatically responds to changes in temperature by activating a heating or cooling system to maintain the temperature at a desired setting.

thesaurus.definition: A publication that provides synonyms (and sometimes antonyms and other semantic relations) for the words of a given language.
examples: "Roget" is the leading brand name for a print English thesaurus that lists words under general concepts rather than just close synonyms.

theseus.definition: A legendary Ancient Greek hero most famous for defeating the minotaur in the labyrinth of Crete.

thesis.definition: Senses relating to logic, rhetoric, etc. A lengthy essay written to establish the validity of a thesis (sense 1.1), especially one submitted in order to complete the requirements for a non-doctoral degree in the US and a doctoral degree in the UK; a dissertation.

thessaloniki.definition: A port city, the capital of Central Macedonia, in northern Greece.

theta.definition: The eighth letter of the Modern Greek alphabet, ninth in Old Greek: Θ, θ.

thetis.definition: One of the nereids; the mother of Achilles

thick.definition: Relatively great in extent from one surface to the opposite in its smallest solid dimension.

thicket.definition: A dense, but generally small, growth of shrubs, bushes or small trees; a copse.

thief.definition: One who carries out a theft.

thigh.definition: The upper leg of a human, between the hip and the knee.

thighbone.definition: The bone that extends from the pelvis to the knee in humans; the femur.

thimble.definition: A pitted, now usually metal, cup-shaped cap worn on the tip of a finger, which is used in sewing to push the needle through material.
A metal ring which a cable or rope intended for attaching to other things is looped around as a protection against chafing.

thin.definition: Having little thickness or extent from one surface to its opposite.
examples: thin plate of metal; thin paper; thin board; thin covering

thin.definition: Very narrow in all diameters; having a cross section that is small in all directions.
examples: thin wire; thin string

thin.definition: Having little body fat or flesh; slim; slender; lean; gaunt.
examples: thin person

thing.definition: That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept.

thing-in-itself.definition: A thing as it is independent of any conceptualization or perception by the human mind, postulated by practical reason but existing in a condition which is in principle unknowable and unexperienceable.

think.definition: To ponder, to go over in one's mind.
examples: Idly, the detective thought what his next move should be.

think.definition: To communicate to oneself in one's mind, to try to find a solution to a problem.
examples: I thought for three hours about the problem and still couldn’t find the solution.

thinker.definition: One who spends time thinking, contemplating or meditating.

third.definition: The ordinal form of the cardinal number three; Coming after the second.
examples: The third tree from the left is my favorite.

third.definition: To divide into three equal parts.

thirst.definition: A sensation of dryness in the throat associated with a craving for liquids, produced by deprivation of drink, or by some other cause (such as fear, excitement, etc.) which stops the secretion of the pharyngeal mucous membrane.
examples: We developed a great thirst during our hike.
He had quite a thirst on and so headed to his favourite Dublin pub.

thirsty.definition: Needing to drink water or any liquid that can supply water.
examples: After all that work in the hot sun, I am really thirsty.

thirteen.definition: The cardinal number occurring after twelve and before fourteen: ten and three.
examples: There are thirteen cards of each of the four suits in a deck of playing cards.
His brother's age is thirteen.

thirty.definition: The cardinal number occurring after twenty-nine and before thirty-one, represented in Arabic numerals as 30.

thirty-eight.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty-seven and preceding thirty-nine.

thirty-five.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty-four and preceding thirty-six.

thirty-four.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty-three and preceding thirty-five.

thirty-nine.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty-eight and preceding forty.

thirty-one.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty and before thirty-two; thirty plus one.

thirty-seven.definition: The cardinal number occurring after thirty-six and before thirty-eight.

thirty-six.definition: The cardinal number immediately following thirty-five and preceding thirty-seven.

thirty-three.definition: The cardinal number after thirty-two and before thirty-four.

thirty-two.definition: The cardinal number after thirty-one and before thirty-three.

thistle.definition: An image of this plant used as a charge.

thomas.definition: An Apostle, best remembered for doubting the resurrection of Jesus.
A male given name from Aramaic of biblical origin, popular since the 13th century.

thong.definition: An item of footwear, usually of rubber, secured by two straps which join to pass between the big toe and its neighbour.

thorn.definition: sharp protective structure of a plant

thoth.definition: The ancient Egyptian moon god of wisdom, learning, and magic, usually depicted as an ibis or baboon.

thought.definition: A representation created in the mind without the use of one's faculties of vision, sound, smell, touch, or taste; an instance of thinking.
examples: The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
I hate the thought of going back to work Monday morning.

thought.definition: The operation by which mental activity arise or are manipulated; the process of thinking; the agency by which thinking is accomplished.
examples: Without freedom of thought there can be no such thing as wisdom, and no such thing as public liberty without freedom of speech.

thousand.definition: A numerical value equal to 1,000; ten times a hundred (1 E+3 exactly—in scientific E notation)
examples: The company earned fifty thousand dollars last month.
Many thousands of people came to the conference.

thread.definition: A cord formed by spinning or twisting together textile fibers or filaments into one or more continuous strands, typically used in needlework.
A unit of execution, lighter in weight than a process, usually sharing memory and other resources with other threads executing concurrently.
A series of posts or messages, consisting of an initial post and responses to it, generally relating to the same subject, on a newsgroup, Internet forum, or social media platform.

threads.definition: A social media platform developed by Meta, integrated into the fediverse.

threat.definition: An expression of intent to injure or punish another.

threaten.definition: To make a threat against someone; to use threats.
examples: He threatened me with a knife.

three.definition: A numerical value equal to 3; the number following two and preceding four.

three-quarter.definition: of three fourths of the usual dimension

threesome.definition: A group of three people or things.
An instance of sexual activity involving three people.

thresh.definition: to separate the grain from the straw or husks

threshold.definition: The lowermost part of a doorway that one crosses to enter; a sill.
An entrance; the door or gate of a house.
The quantitative point at which an action is triggered, especially a lower limit.
The wage or salary at which income tax becomes due.
The point where one is mentally or physically vulnerable in response to a provocation or to other nuisances.

thrive.definition: to increase in bulk or stature

throat.definition: The front part of the neck.
examples: The wild pitch bounced and hit the catcher in the throat.

throaty.definition: Produced in the throat; having a rough or coarse quality like a sound produced in the throat.
examples: A throaty cough.

thrombosis.definition: The formation of thrombi in the blood vessels of a living organism, causing obstruction of the circulation.

throne.definition: An impressive seat used by a monarch, often on a raised dais in a throne room and reserved for formal occasions.
examples: He approached the throne reverently.

throw.definition: To eject or cause to fall off.
examples: the horse threw its rider

throw.definition: To cause a certain number on the die or dice to be shown after rolling it.
The flight of a thrown object.

thrush.definition: Any of numerous species of songbirds of the cosmopolitan family Turdidae, such as the song thrush, mistle thrush, bluebird, and American robin.

thrust.definition: An attack made by moving the sword parallel to its length and landing with the point.
examples: Pierre was a master swordsman, and could parry the thrusts of lesser men with barely a thought.

thucydides.definition: A great ancient Greek historian (c. 460 BCE – c. 395 BCE) and author of the History of the Peloponnesian War, which recounts the 5th century BCE war between Sparta and Athens to the year 411 BCE.

thug.definition: someone who treats others violently or roughly

thumb.definition: The shortest and thickest digit of the hand that for humans has the most mobility and can be made to oppose (moved to touch) all of the other fingers.

thumbelina.definition: A fairy tale about a thumb-sized girl.

thun.definition: A city and municipality of Bern canton, Switzerland.

thunder.definition: The loud rumbling, cracking, or crashing sound caused by expansion of rapidly heated air around a lightning bolt.
examples: Thunder is preceded by lightning.
Thunder cracked overhead.

thunder.definition: To make a noise like thunder.
examples: The train thundered along the tracks.

thunderstorm.definition: A storm consisting of thunder and lightning produced by a cumulonimbus, usually accompanied with heavy rain, wind, and sometimes hail; and in rarer cases sleet, freezing rain, or snow.

thursday.definition: The fifth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the fourth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Wednesday and precedes Friday.

examples: I have all the tools I need; thus, I will be able to fix the car without having to call a mechanic.

thwart.definition: To cause to fail; to frustrate, to prevent.
examples: Our plans for a picnic were thwarted by the thunderstorm.
The police thwarted the would-be assassin.

thwart.definition: A seat across a boat on which a rower may sit.
examples: The fisherman sat on the aft thwart to row.

thy.definition: Possessive form of thou: that which belongs to thee; which belongs to you (singular).

thyme.definition: Any plant of the labiate genus Thymus, such as garden thyme (Thymus vulgaris), a warm, pungent aromatic, that is much used to give a relish to seasoning and soups.

tianjin.definition: A direct-administered municipality and major city in northern China, between Beijing and the Bohai Bay.

tiberias.definition: A town in the Northern District, on the Sea of Galilee in Israel.

tibet.definition: An autonomous region of China. Official name: Tibet Autonomous Region. Capital: Lhasa.

tic-tac-toe.definition: A game in which two players take turns placing circles and crosses on a 3x3 grid and attempt to obtain three of the same symbols in a straight line.

tick.definition: A tiny woodland arachnid of the suborder Ixodida.

tick-tock.definition: The sound of the ticking of an analog clock.

ticket.definition: A small document that acts as proof of something, often thereby granting the holder some ability. A pass entitling the holder to admission to a show, concert, sporting event, etc.
examples: I've got two tickets for the match on Saturday; want to come?

ticket.definition: A small document that acts as proof of something, often thereby granting the holder some ability. A pass entitling the holder to board a train, a bus, a plane, or other means of transportation.
examples: train ticket   bus ticket   plane ticket
You must show your ticket to the conductor.

tickle.definition: To touch repeatedly or stroke delicately in a manner which typically causes laughter, pleasure and twitching.
examples: He tickled Nancy's tummy, and she started to giggle.

tidepool.definition: A rocky pool by the ocean that is filled with seawater left behind by the falling tide.
examples: They peeked into the tidepool and found starfish and anemones.

tie.definition: To attach or fasten (one thing to another) by string or the like.
examples: Tie him to the tree.

tiebeam.definition: A beam acting as a tie, as at the bottom of a pair of principal rafters, to prevent them from thrusting out the wall.

tier.definition: A rank or grade; a stratum.
examples: Stoke City were playing in the second tier of English football before being promoted to the Premier League.

tightening.definition: The act or process of making more tight.

tigray.definition: A geographic region of Horn of Africa; the region of the Tigrinya-speaking peoples

tigrayan.definition: Of or relating to the Tigray Region in northern Ethiopia and Eritrea.
A member of a Tigrinya-speaking ethnic group found in the Tigray Region.

tigrinya.definition: A Semitic language of Eritrea and Ethiopia. It is written in the Ge'ez alphabet.

tigris.definition: A river in West Asia flowing 1,150 miles east-southeast from the Armenian Highland in Turkey through Iraq. It forms the eastern edge of classical Mesopotamia. It unites with the Euphrates River to form the Shatt al-Arab before flowing into the Persian Gulf.

tijuana.definition: The largest city in Baja California, Mexico, by the American border with San Diego.

tilapia.definition: Any of various edible fish, formerly species of the genus Tilapia, but now placed in other cichlid genera (such as Oreochromis), native to Africa and the Middle East but cultivated worldwide.

tile.definition: A regularly-shaped slab of clay or other material, affixed to cover or decorate a surface, as in a roof-tile, glazed tile, stove tile, carpet tile, etc.

till.definition: Until; to, up to; as late as (a given time).
examples: She stayed till the very end.
I have to work till eight o'clock tonight.
Maybe you can, maybe you can't: you won't know till you try.

tiller.definition: The handle of the rudder which the helmsman holds to steer the boat, a piece of wood or metal extending forward from the rudder over or through the transom. Generally attached at the top of the rudder.

time.definition: An instant of time. An instance or occurrence.
examples: one more time
When was the last time we went out? I don’t remember.
See you another time.
That’s three times he’s made the same mistake.
Okay, but this is the last time. No more after that!

time.definition: An instant of time. Closing time.
examples: Last call: it's almost time.

time.definition: A ratio of comparison (see also usage notes and prepositional sense at 'times').
examples: Your car runs three times faster than mine.
That is four times as heavy as this.

time-traveller.definition: One who engages in time travel.

timer.definition: Agent noun of time: someone or something that times. A device used to measure amounts of time.
examples: start the timer when you hear the gunshot

timetable.definition: A tabular schedule of events with the times at which they occur, especially times of arrivals and departures.
examples: The timetable has been changed several times since it was first announced.

timon.definition: A male given name from Ancient Greek of mostly historical use.

tin.definition: A malleable, ductile, metallic element, resistant to corrosion, with atomic number 50 and symbol Sn.

tinnitus.definition: The experience of auditory sensations, such as a ringing or pulsating sound, occurring in the absence of any external stimulus.

tip.definition: A small monetary gift. A gratuity; a small amount of money left for a bartender, waiter, taxi driver or other service worker as a token of appreciation, often calculated as a percentage of the bill.
examples: Workers in the American service industry usually depend on tips to even make minimum wage.

tip.definition: A piece of private or secret information, especially imparted by someone with expert knowledge about sporting odds, business performance etc.
examples: hot stock tips

tiramisu.definition: An Italian semifreddo dessert, originally from Veneto, made from ladyfinger biscuits, cocoa, mascarpone cheese, Marsala wine, eggs (or sometimes cream), sugar and espresso coffee.

tiran.definition: Ellipsis of Tiran Island: an island formerly of Egypt, since 2017 of Saudi Arabia, located between the southern end of the Sinai Peninsula and Arabian Peninsula.

tirana.definition: capital and largest city of Albania

tiraspol.definition: A city and municipality of Transnistria, Moldova.

tired.definition: In need of some rest or sleep.

tishrei.definition: The first month of the civil year and the seventh month of the ecclesiastical year in the Jewish calendar, after Elul and before Cheshvan.

tissue.definition: A sheet of absorbent paper, especially one that is made to be used as tissue paper, toilet paper or a handkerchief.
A group of cells (along with their extracellular matrix if any) that are similar in origin and function together to perform a specific job.

titanic.definition: The RMS Titanic, an ocean liner, thought by the public to be unsinkable, that sank on its maiden voyage on 15 April 1912 after colliding with an iceberg.
examples: The Titanic story inspired a movie considered as one of the best of all time.

titanium.definition: A chemical element (symbol Ti), atomic number 22; it is a strong, corrosion-resistant transition metal, used to make light alloys for aircraft etc.
examples: This airframe uses titanium alloys extensively.

tithe.definition: A contribution to one's religious community or congregation of worship (notably to the LDS church).

titian.definition: A male given name from Latin, equivalent to Italian Tiziano, notably used in reference to Tiziano Vecellio (c. 1488/1490 – 1576), an Italian Renaissance painter.

title.definition: prefix or suffix added to a name

titus.definition: Titus Caesar Vespasianus, a Roman Emperor who succeeded Vespasian and preceded Domitian.
A male given name from Latin.

to.definition: A particle used for marking the following verb as an infinitive.
examples: I want to leave.
He asked me what to do.

you.definition: A dummy pronoun used in certain constructions, usually with verbs of receiving (such as get or find) or sensing (such as see or hear), typically stating the existence or typicality of something.
examples: You get a lot of rude people in London.
It was one of those small-town dive bars you often read about.

you.definition: object pronoun: the person being addressed
subject pronoun: the person being addressed
The individual or group spoken or written to.
examples: Have you gentlemen come to see the lady who fell backwards off a bus?

you.definition: Used before epithets, describing the person being addressed, for emphasis.
examples: You idiot!

you-know-what.definition: The name of something the speaker does not want to mention, but which is known, or very likely to be known, to the listener.

you-know-who.definition: Person or entity whose name one does not want to mention but which is known to the person to whom one is speaking.

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.
examples: a lamb is a young sheep
these picture books are for young readers
Come skydiving with us. Come on, you're only young once!

your.definition: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (singular; one owner).
examples: Let’s meet tomorrow at your convenience.
Is this your cat?

your.definition: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (plural; more owners).

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.
examples: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.
There was a group of youths hanging around the parking lot, reading fashion magazines and listening to music.

youth.definition: A young man; a male adolescent or young adult.

examples: Anthony just subscribed to someone on YouTube a day ago.

yttrium.definition: A silvery metallic chemical element with an atomic number of 39, mainly found in combination with lanthanide elements in rare earth minerals.

yuan.definition: The basic unit of money in China.

yuck.definition: Uttered to indicate disgust usually toward an objectionable taste or odour.
examples: Yuck! This peanut butter is disgusting!

yuppie.definition: A young upwardly mobile urban professional person with an affluent lifestyle.

yurt.definition: A large, round, semi-permanent tent with vertical walls and a conical roof, usually associated with Central Asia and Mongolia (where it is known as a ger).

yuzhno-sakhalinsk.definition: A city, the administrative centre of Sakhalin Oblast, on Sakhalin Island, in the Far East of Russia.

zaatar.definition: A particular herb, similar in flavor to thyme or oregano, used in Middle Eastern cuisine (Origanum syriacum).
A Middle Eastern seasoning, having this herb or a mixture of herbs as the main ingredient, with sumac (or other tart-flavored equivalent) and sesame seeds.

zabaglione.definition: A custard-like dessert made with egg yolks, sugar and Marsala wine.

zachary.definition: A male given name from Hebrew.

zaire.definition: Former name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a country in Central Africa; used from 1971–1997.

zakat.definition: Almsgiving, usually in the form of an annual tax on certain types of property which is then used for charitable purposes; the third of the five pillars of Islam.

zakynthos.definition: An island of Greece, on the Ionian Sea; the third-largest Ionian island.

zalishchyky.definition: A city in Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine.

zaragoza.definition: A city, the regional capital of Aragon, Spain.

zayin.definition: The seventh letter of many Semitic alphabets (Phoenician, Aramaic, Hebrew, Syriac, Arabic and others).

zealot.definition: One who is zealous, one who is full of zeal for their own specific beliefs or objectives, usually in the negative sense of being too passionate; a fanatic.

A member of a radical, warlike, ardently patriotic group of Jews in Judea, particularly prominent in the first century, who advocated the violent overthrow of Roman rule and vigorously resisted the efforts of the Romans and their supporters to convert the Jews.

zealously.definition: Like, or in the manner of, a zealot; with great zeal or zealotry.
examples: working zealously
zealously defend someone
zealously guarded

zebedee.definition: The father of the Apostles James and John in the Bible.

zebra.definition: A biracial person, specifically one born to a Sub-Saharan African person and a white person.

zebulun.definition: Tenth son of Jacob, by his wife Leah.
A male given name from Hebrew.

zechariah.definition: A king of Israel mentioned in the second book of Kings.
A Hebrew prophet traditionally considered the author of the Book of Zechariah, the eleventh of the Twelve Minor Prophets.

zee.definition: The name of the Latin script letter Z/z.

zeitgeist.definition: The spirit of the age; the taste, outlook, and spirit characteristic of a period.

zelda.definition: Ellipsis of The Legend of Zelda.

zemfira.definition: A transliteration of the Russian female given name Земфи́ра (Zemfíra).

zemlyanka.definition: Dugout, earth-house (shelter or dwelling, especially in some Slavic countries).

zen.definition: A school of Mahayana Buddhism characterized by sudden enlightenment achieved by indirect means and principally associated with China and Japan.

zenith.definition: The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zephyr.definition: Any light refreshing wind; a gentle breeze.

zermatt.definition: A municipality and ski resort town in Valais canton, Switzerland.

zero.definition: The cardinal number occurring before one and that denotes no quantity or amount at all, represented in Arabic numerals as 0.
examples: The conductor waited until the passenger count was zero.
A cheque for zero dollars and zero cents crashed the computers on division by zero.

zero.definition: point of origin on a scale
To set some amount to be zero.
examples: They tried to zero the budget by the end of the quarter.
Results were inconsistent because an array wasn’t zeroed during initialization.
Zero the fluorometer with the same solvent used in extraction.
George parked in space 34, zeroed the trip meter, closed and locked his car, then went back to the guard shack.

zerubbabel.definition: a governor of the Persian Province of Judah, who led the first group of Jews returned from the Babylonian Captivity.

zest.definition: Enthusiasm; keen enjoyment; exciting and interesting; relish or gusto; a state of being zesty.
examples: Auntie Mame had a real zest for life.

zeta.definition: The sixth letter of the modern Greek alphabet (Ζ, ζ) preceded by epsilon (Ε, ε) and followed by eta, (Η, η); or the seventh letter in the ancient Greek alphabet, in which it is preceded by digamma (Ϝ, ϝ)

zeus.definition: The supreme Deity and ruler of all Hellenic gods in Hellenism, husband to Hera.

zhukov.definition: A transliteration of the Russian surname Жу́ков (Žúkov).

ziggurat.definition: A temple tower of the ancient Mesopotamian valley, having the form of a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories

zigzag.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zimbabwe.definition: A country in Southern Africa. Official name: Republic of Zimbabwe. Formerly called Southern Rhodesia or Rhodesia.

zinfandel.definition: A dry red wine of California.
A small black grape from which zinfandel wine is made.

zion.definition: A hill in West Jerusalem, in Israel, on which ancient Jerusalem was partly built; a centrepiece to Biblical accounts of old days and future eschatological events.

zionism.definition: Jewish nationalism, the movement which supported first the establishment of a Jewish homeland and now supports the continuation of Israel as a Jewish state.

zipline.definition: A pulley suspended on a cable mounted on an incline, designed to enable a user to travel from one point to another by means of gravity.

zirconium.definition: A chemical element (symbol Zr) with an atomic number of 40, a strong, lustrous, grey-white transition metal mainly used as a refractory and opacifier.

zither.definition: A musical instrument consisting of a flat sounding box with numerous strings placed on a horizontal surface, played with a plectrum or fingertips.

zloty.definition: The currency unit of Poland, divided into 100 groszy.

zombie.definition: A person, usually undead, animated by unnatural forces (such as magic), with no soul or will of his or her own, typically being slow, obedient, and harmless unless directed to be harmful.

zone.definition: A given area distinguished on the basis of a particular characteristic, use, restriction, etc.
examples: There is a no-smoking zone that extends 25 feet outside of each entrance.
The white zone is for loading and unloading only.
Files in the Internet zone are blocked by default, as a security measure.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.
examples: The London Zoo was built in 1828.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.

zoom.definition: An augmentation of a view, by varying the focal length of a lens, or digitally.
examples: What's the zoom like on your camera?

zoophilia.definition: sexual attraction to or interaction with animals

zoophobia.definition: An unusual fear of non-human animals.
examples: The girl who had zoophobia didn't like animals, domestic or wild.

zoroaster.definition: An ancient Iranian prophet after whom the indigenous Iranian ethnic religion, Zoroastrianism, is named, also venerated in Mithraism.

zoroastrianism.definition: Mazdaism, the surviving form of the indigenous (pre-Islamic) Iranian ethnic religion.

zorro.definition: A fictional character, a daring and mysterious avenger, created in 1919 by pulp writer Johnston McCulley.

zubron.definition: A hybrid between domestic cattle and wisent.

zubrowka.definition: A dry straw-colored liqueur of vodka flavored with herbs, originally from Poland.

zuckerberg.definition: An Ashkenazic Jewish surname from German.

zugzwang.definition: A situation in which a player is forced to make a disadvantageous move; a position where any legal move will worsen a player's situation.

zurich.definition: The capital city of Zurich canton, Switzerland, on Lake Zurich.

zygote.definition: A eukaryotic cell formed from the fusion of two gametes (“reproductive cells”) during a fertilization process.
